question: I forgot my password?
answer: Forget password flow can be used from login screen by entering debit card number and pin code

question: I have changed my device, do i need to register to application
answer: No, once you download application from store and same credentials are entered, application will send you a new OTP to verify your identity and ask for new biometrics to be enabled.

question: I forgot my username?
answer: Call center agent can retrieve it from bank employee portal and give it to customer after asking security questions.

question: Can i keep same password in Capital mobile application?
answer: Yes, same password can be used

question: Do i need to enter my username / password every time i login?
answer: No, it’s just one time to complete the migration flow as the biometrics/ personal pin flow will be used.

question: What happens after three unsuccessful login attempts?
answer: After three unsuccessful login attempts, user’s credentials will be blocked for 10 min which will unblocked automatically afterwards.

question: What happens if a bank employee blocks username access?
answer: If Bank’s employee blocked username access for any internal procedurals measure, only bank employee can unblock this user and not automatically by application counter.

question: How can I reset my password?
answer: Reset password can be done directly from application by using change password / forget password features
